description: Numbers produced by the pre-move harness, scripts/eval_tool_retrieval.py in bamboo-mcp, keyed by catalogue fingerprint. Phase 0's acceptance criterion is that bamboo-eval reproduces them exactly on the same catalogue. A fingerprint absent from this file skips the parity test with instructions rather than failing it, because a different catalogue is a different measurement and has nothing to be compared against.
how_to_add_a_fingerprint: In a bamboo-mcp checkout at the commit under test, run:
Copy catalog_fingerprint, and each report's recall_at_k, recall_at_k_hard,
into a new block below, verbatim. Do not round and do not re-derive them from
bamboo-eval: the point of the block is that it was produced by the other harness.
